description.en: Copies an image's width and height into an array: element 0 the width, element 1 the height (only as many elements as the array has, at most 2).

true once copied, false if the image is not found.
null if the script system is not ready or fewer than 2 arguments are given.

examples.case: Sizing a caption (real usage, from ie4_ev_sub_skl.nut)
